text:
Jo: Quick proposal  one-page 'manager week1 cheat' to include in offer emails. copy-paste friendly, <4h scheduled.
Priya: Yes please. include who-to-contact snippets for IT / Security / Facilities / Legal. managers hate hunting.
Sam: Add a prioritized security checklist (MFA, disk encryption, KMS request). mark Must / ASAP / Optional.
Diego: Also give a tiny 30/60/90 starter + 1:1 agenda snippet they can paste.
Jo: Draft below. short calendar bundle + copyable lines. feedback?
Jo: Pre-start (3 business days before): open Okta + infra tickets, confirm laptop shipping, assign buddy, badge request if office.
Priya: Who-to-contact quick lines (copy/paste):
- IT: "Hi IT  please provision Okta group ROLE and laptop for NAME (start DATE)."
- Security: "Hi Security  request KMS and runbook access for NAME."
- Facilities: "Badge access for NAME on START_DATE to BUILDING."
- Legal: "Please attach required NDAs & customer-sensitive docs for NAME."
Sam: Security checklist (prioritized):
- MUST: enable MFA, corporate device disk encryption, Okta group access.
- ASAP: KMS key access, incident runbook read access.
- OPTIONAL: elevated audit/log access, extra monitoring alerts.
Jo: 30/60/90 starter (copyable):
- 30d: meet core partners, confirm team access, ship one small operational improvement.
- 60d: own a prioritized backlog item, run first planning cadence, gather feedback.
- 90d: deliver measurable improvement, draft team OKRs, present progress to stakeholders.
Diego: 1:1 agenda snippet to paste: "Wins (5m) / Blockers (5m) / Priorities (3m) / Support needed (2m)"
Jo: Pasteable calendar bundle for offers:
- Day1 09:30 - PeopleOps: Welcome & Admin (45m)
- Day1 11:00 - Team intro / meet & greet (30m)
- Day2 10:00 - Product overview (45m)
- Day3 10:00 - 30/60/90 workshop (45m)
- Day4 09:30 - Infra & security primer (60m)
- Day5 15:00 - Stakeholder intro + week recap (30m)
Priya: Add a compliance flag: "If role touches regulated data, schedule Legal + Security intake in week 1."
Sam: Proposal: short 5-question end-of-week survey (access issues, missing docs, unclear owners, too many meetings, pace). if 'access issues' checked, tag IT.
Diego: I'll build a Google Calendar template and a one-page PDF cheat sheet.
OnboardBot: New-manager one-pager queued for People Ops review. Link: https://redwood.link/manager-week1-cheat
Jo: Thanks all. Can people review by Thursday EOD? small edits only. :sparkles:
